description: atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr: flood hazard datasets (enjeux ponctuels) is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Coverage: the area served by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. The listing groups 11 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Enjeux ponctuels du PPRi Moselle Amont révisé pour la commune de Bussa; Enjeux ponctuels pris en compte dans le PPRI de l'Avre aval; Enjeux ponctuels lors des inondations de la Vouge en Côte-d'Or; Enjeux ponctuels (équipements publics) du PPRI Touques Moyenne Orbique. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
